description: Find HEPData measurement records by physics content — process, observable, energy, collaboration — when the paper is unknown, through INSPIRE-HEP's index of every HEPData submission. Each hit carries the paper recids (pass to cern_inspire_get_paper), collaborations, keywords (reactions such as "P P --> TOP TOPBAR X", observables, centre-of-mass energies), the HEPData record DOI (recordDoi, the citation for the data), latest version, table count, and hepdataUrl, the hepdata.net record page that holds the table values; this tool does not return the values themselves. Only the first 10,000 results of a query are reachable.

page.description: Page number, starting at 1. page × size may not exceed 10,000.

query.description: Free text or INSPIRE syntax over HEPData records, e.g. top pair differential cross section 13 TeV; collaborations.value:LHCb; keywords.value:"Inclusive"; or literature.control_number:<recid> for one paper's data. INSPIRE does not reject malformed syntax; see cern_inspire_list_reference topic search_syntax.

name: cern_inspire_search_hepdata

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `beyond_result_window`: page × size exceeds the 10,000 results INSPIRE serves for one query. `invalid_query`: INSPIRE answered 400 to a parameter value it refuses. `inspire_rate_limited`: INSPIRE returned 429 after the pacer and retries. `pacer_shed`: The server's outbound INSPIRE queue could not start the request within the call's remaining budget. `upstream_unreadable`: The INSPIRE body exceeded the byte ceiling, was HTML where JSON was expected, or was invalid JSON. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

hasMore.description: True when INSPIRE has a further page of results.

nextPage.description: The page number to request next, when one exists within the 10,000-result window.

notice.description: Guidance on an empty or paged result.

records.description: The HEPData records on this page, in the requested order.

abstractSnippet.description: Start of the first abstract with text, as text (numeric character references and 13 common named entities such as < and & decoded, other named entities left as written; publisher markup converted; LaTeX left as published), up to 300 characters at a word boundary.

abstractTruncated.description: True when the abstract continues past the snippet.

citationCount.description: Citations INSPIRE counts for the data record.

created.description: Date INSPIRE created the data record.

experiments.description: Experiments credited, by INSPIRE legacy name.

hepdataRecid.description: HEPData record number, parsed from the record DOI: the N in hepdata.net/record/N. It is not an INSPIRE recid; pass one of paperRecids to cern_inspire_get_paper.

hepdataUrl.description: The HEPData record page on hepdata.net, where the table values are read: keyed by hepdataRecid, or by the first of paperRecids (/record/ins followed by that recid) when the record DOI names no number.

inspireDataRecid.description: Record ID of the HEPData entry in INSPIRE's data collection.

keywords.description: HEPData keywords: reactions, observables, phrases, centre-of-mass energies.

items.description: Keyword as INSPIRE stores it, e.g. "cmenergies: 13000.0-13000.0".

paperRecids.description: Literature records the data belongs to; pass to cern_inspire_get_paper.

recordDoi.description: HEPData record DOI; cite it when reusing the data.

tableCount.description: Number of tables in the latest version.

title.description: Title of the HEPData submission (usually the paper title) as text: publisher markup converted (scripts as _x or ^{xy}), LaTeX left as published.

shown.description: Number of records on this page.

totalCount.description: Total HEPData records the query matched.

truncated.description: True when more results exist beyond this page.

title: Search HEPData records
